data.name: Minsar
data.gender_notes: Minsar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-s-r’ which means ‘a fortress’ or ‘a sanctuary’. The name Minsar is often given to a child as a reminder to be a protector, a defender, and a strong individual who can provide safety and security to those around him. The name Minsar carries the meaning “A fortress or a sanctuary” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Minsar usually hope their child will grow to embody a fortress or a sanctuary and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with strength and protection, symbolizing one's commitment to shield and defend.
data.etymology: Minsar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A fortress or a sanctuary.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minsar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: منصار
in_arabic.meaning: منصار هو اسم يعني الشخص الذي ينصر ويساعد الآخرين
in_arabic.long_meaning: منصار هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ن-ص-ر' والذي يعني النصر والمساعدة. يستخدم الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يساعد وينصر الآخرين في أوقات الحاجة. ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَكَانَ النَّصْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ' (سورة آل عمران، الآية 126)، مما يعزز الأهمية الدينية والروحية لهذا الاسم.

in_urdu.name: منصار
in_urdu.meaning: منصار وہ نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جو لوگوں کی مدد کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: منصار ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ن-ص-ر' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا یا نصیرت کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ ان شخصیات کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو دوسروں کی مدد اور حمایت کے لئے جانی جاتی ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام ان ممتاز شخصیات کو بھی دیا گیا ہے جنہوں نے اسلامی معاشرے میں اہم کردار ادا کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मिंसार
in_hindi.meaning: मिंसार का अर्थ है जो लोगो की मदद करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिंसार नाम अरबी मूल का है, जो 'न-ص-र' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना या सहायता करना। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह उन व्यक्तियों की विशेषता को दर्शाता है जो दूसरों की मदद और समर्थन के लिए जाने जाते हैं। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी किया जाता है, जहां यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक मूल्यों को प्रतिबिंबित करता है।

in_pashto.name: منصار
in_pashto.meaning: منصار دى هغه کسى نوم دی چه د خلکو مرست وکړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: منصار د عربى ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې د 'ن-ص-ر' ريښې څخه مشتق شوی دی، مانا یې د مرستې او ملاتړ معنی ورکوي. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو ځانګړتیا څرګندوي چې د نورو سره مرسته کوي. دا نوم د پښتنو په ډېرو کورنیو کې کارول کېږي او د ده د معنوي ارزښتونو د يو ښه انځورګر دی.

in_english.name: Minsar
in_english.meaning: Minsar means one who helps or supports others
in_english.long_meaning: The name Minsar originates from the Arabic root 'n-ṣ-r', which means to help or support. This name is significant in Islamic culture as it reflects the qualities of a person who assists and supports others in times of need. The root 'n-ṣ-r' is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Al Imran, Verse 126: 'And victory is not except from Allah, the Almighty.' This underscores the religious and spiritual importance of the name Minsar. Historically, the name has been associated with notable figures in Islamic society who were known for their support and aid to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Minsar holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic tradition as it symbolizes strength, resilience, and protection. Historically, in Islamic civilizations, a minsar would often be a fortified tower where people would seek refuge during times of war or conflict. Today, the name serves as a reminder of the importance of building a strong character and providing security and protection to our loved ones and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Minsar holds great significance as it is a reminder of the role of every individual in being a source of protection and strength for others. Muslims believe that each one of us has a duty to protect and defend the faith, the weak, and the vulnerable. The name Minsar serves as a constant reminder of this responsibility and calls each person to strive to be a protecter and a defender in their own unique way. Furthermore, the name also carries the symbolism of seeking refuge in Allah, the only true protector and defender.
